heading.en: Party, Civil War and district commands

body.zh-Hant: 據《俄羅斯史百科全書》，伏羅希洛夫1903年加入布爾什維克，此後近十年處於地下或流放狀態，1917年底出任彼得格勒委員。內戰期間他參與1918年的察里津戰役，在該處站在史達林一方。立陶宛通用百科全書另載，他1921至24年任北高加索軍區部隊司令，1924至25年任莫斯科軍區部隊司令。
body.en: According to the Encyclopedia of Russian History, Voroshilov joined the Bolsheviks in 1903, spent nearly a decade underground and in exile, and in late 1917 became commissar of Petrograd. In the Civil War he took part in the 1918 fighting at Tsaritsyn, where he sided with Stalin. The Lithuanian Universal Encyclopedia adds that he commanded the North Caucasus military district in 1921-24 and the Moscow military district in 1924-25.

citations.quote: spent nearly a decade underground and in exile
emerged in late 1917 to become the commissar of Petrograd
including Tsaritsyn in 1918, where he sided with Josef V. Stalin against
1921–24 Šiaurės Kaukazo, 1924–25 Maskvos karinės apygardos kariuomenės vadas.

heading.zh-Hant: 軍事與海軍事務、國防人民委員
heading.en: People's Commissar for military and naval affairs and for defence

body.zh-Hant: 《俄羅斯史百科全書》載，1925年底伏龍芝去世後，伏羅希洛夫任軍事與海軍事務人民委員至1934年中，其後任國防人民委員至1940年5月。同條目稱他在1930年代推動紅軍機械化，並曾支持T-34坦克。立陶宛通用百科全書則說他參與軍中鎮壓，並因蘇芬戰爭戰事不順於1940年被免職。
body.en: The Encyclopedia of Russian History records that after Frunze's death in late 1925 Voroshilov was commissar of military and naval affairs until mid-1934 and then defence commissar until May 1940. It says he oversaw the mechanization of the Red Army in the 1930s, including support for the T-34 tank. The Lithuanian encyclopedia adds that he took part in repressions in the army and was removed in 1940 as the Soviet-Finnish war went badly.

citations.quote: Following the death of Mikhail V. Frunze in late 1925
served until mid-1934 as commissar of military and naval affairs
and subsequently until May 1940 as defense commissar
he oversaw an impressive campaign for the mechanization of the Red Army
including support for the T-34 tank over Stalin's initial objections

body.zh-Hant: 據《俄羅斯史百科全書》，伏羅希洛夫在二戰期間擔任重要的指揮與顧問職務，但被評為與其說是嚴肅的指揮官，不如說是政治附庸，結果往往不佳。立陶宛通用百科全書載他1941至44年為國家防衛委員會成員，1942至43年任游擊運動總司令，1945至47年任盟國駐匈牙利管制委員會主席。史達林死後的1953年，他出任最高蘇維埃主席團主席，1960年被迫辭職。
body.en: According to the Encyclopedia of Russian History, Voroshilov held important command and advisory posts in the Second World War but was judged more a political toady than a serious commander, often with baleful results. The Lithuanian encyclopedia lists him as a member of the State Defence Committee in 1941-44, commander-in-chief of the partisan movement in 1942-43, and chairman of the Allied Control Commission in Hungary in 1945-47. After Stalin's death in 1953 he became chairman of the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet, and was forced to resign in 1960.

body.zh-Hant: 據聖彼得堡百科全書，戈沃羅夫生於1897年，1916年入彼得格勒工學院並同年被徵入伍，在康士坦丁諾夫炮兵學校完成速成課程。他1918至19年曾在高爾察克海軍上將的軍隊服役，1920年起入紅軍，1932年畢業於伏龍芝軍事學院，1938年畢業於總參謀學院。
body.en: According to the Saint Petersburg encyclopaedia, Govorov was born in 1897, enrolled at the Petrograd Polytechnic Institute in 1916 and was drafted the same year, completing an accelerated course at the Konstantinovsky artillery school. He served in Admiral Kolchak's army in 1918-19, joined the Red Army in 1920, and graduated from the Frunze Military Academy in 1932 and the General Staff Academy in 1938.

completed an accelerated training course at the Konstantinovsky artillery school
In 1918-19 served in the army of Admiral A.V. Kolchak, from 1920 in the Red Army
He graduated from Frunze Military Academy (1932)

heading.zh-Hant: 蘇芬戰爭與莫斯科戰場
heading.en: Winter War and the Moscow front

body.zh-Hant: 聖彼得堡百科全書載，戈沃羅夫在1939至40年的蘇芬戰爭中任第7集團軍炮兵主任，1940至41年任紅軍副炮兵總監。1941年10月起，他指揮駐於莫斯科附近的第5集團軍；立陶宛通用百科全書稱他在莫斯科戰役中統率第5集團軍。1942年4月，他轉任列寧格勒方面軍。
body.en: The Saint Petersburg encyclopaedia records that in the Soviet-Finnish War of 1939-40 Govorov was chief of artillery staff of the 7th Army and in 1940-41 deputy inspector general of artillery of the Red Army. From October 1941 he commanded the 5th Army near Moscow, and the Lithuanian encyclopedia says he led it in the battle of Moscow. In April 1942 he moved to the Leningrad Front.

citations.quote: was appointed Chief of Artillery Staff of the 7th Army
In 1940-41, served as Deputy Inspector General of Artillery of the Red Army

heading.zh-Hant: 列寧格勒方面軍與戰後

body.zh-Hant: 據聖彼得堡百科全書，戈沃羅夫自1942年4月起統率列寧格勒方面軍，領導1943年的突破封鎖與1944年的解除封鎖行動，並參與解放波羅的海地區。1944年他獲授蘇聯元帥，1944年10月起協調列寧格勒一帶的作戰，1945至46年任列寧格勒軍區司令。立陶宛通用百科全書另載，他1948至54年任蘇聯防空軍司令。
body.en: According to the Saint Petersburg encyclopaedia, Govorov commanded the Leningrad Front from April 1942, led the operations that broke the blockade in 1943 and lifted it in 1944, and took part in the liberation of the Baltic. He became Marshal of the Soviet Union in 1944, coordinated operations around Leningrad from October 1944 and commanded the Leningrad Military District in 1945-46. The Lithuanian encyclopedia adds that he commanded the USSR air-defence forces in 1948-54.

heading.en: Early life and Spanish Civil War

body.zh-Hant: 據《大蘇維埃百科全書》，梅列茨科夫1897年生於農民家庭，1918年入紅軍，1921年畢業於紅軍軍事學院。他曾任莫斯科與白俄羅斯軍區參謀長、特別紅旗遠東集團軍參謀長及副總參謀長，並於1936至37年作為志願者參加西班牙內戰。
body.en: According to the Great Soviet Encyclopedia, Meretskov was born in 1897 to a peasant family, joined the Red Army in 1918 and graduated from the Red Army Military Academy in 1921. He served as chief of staff of the Moscow and Belorussian military districts and of the Special Red Banner Far Eastern Army, and as deputy chief of the General Staff, and volunteered in the Spanish Civil War in 1936-37.

citations.quote: В 1936—37 участвовал добровольцем в Гражданской войне в Испании

heading.en: Winter War and Chief of the General Staff

body.zh-Hant: 《大蘇維埃百科全書》載，蘇芬戰爭（1939至40年）期間，梅列茨科夫指揮第7集團軍，該軍參與突破維堡方向的曼納海姆防線，1940年3月他獲蘇聯英雄稱號。1940年8月起他任總參謀長，1941年1月起任國防人民委員副手。戰爭初期他先後指揮第7、第4、第33集團軍，並主持了季赫溫附近擊潰德軍的行動。
body.en: The Great Soviet Encyclopedia records that in the Soviet-Finnish War of 1939-40 Meretskov commanded the 7th Army, which took part in breaking the Mannerheim Line in the Vyborg direction, and that he was made Hero of the Soviet Union in March 1940. From August 1940 he was Chief of the General Staff and from January 1941 deputy People's Commissar of Defence. Early in the war he commanded the 7th, 4th and 33rd armies and directed the defeat of German forces at Tikhvin.

citations.quote: Во время советско-финской войны 1939—40 командовал 7-й армией
принимавшей участие в прорыве линии Маннергейма на выборгском направлении
с января 1941 заместитель наркома обороны СССР
руководил разгромом немецко-фашистских войск под Тихвином

heading.zh-Hant: 沃爾霍夫、卡累利阿與遠東戰線
heading.en: Volkhov, Karelian and Far Eastern fronts

body.zh-Hant: 據《大蘇維埃百科全書》，梅列茨科夫1941年12月至1944年2月指揮沃爾霍夫方面軍，1944年2至11月指揮卡累利阿方面軍，1945年4月起指揮濱海集群，同年8月任遠東第1方面軍司令，該方面軍參與擊潰滿洲與北朝鮮的日軍。聖彼得堡百科全書稱，沃爾霍夫方面軍1944年1至2月的諾夫哥羅德—盧加戰役促成了解除列寧格勒之圍，該方面軍由梅列茨科夫統率。
body.en: According to the Great Soviet Encyclopedia, Meretskov commanded the Volkhov Front from December 1941 to February 1944 and the Karelian Front from February to November 1944, led the Primorye Group of Forces from April 1945, and in August 1945 commanded the 1st Far Eastern Front, which took part in defeating Japanese forces in Manchuria and North Korea. The Saint Petersburg encyclopaedia says the Volkhov Front's Novgorod-Luga operation of January-February 1944 resulted in the lifting of the siege of Leningrad and that the front was commanded by Meretskov.

body.zh-Hant: 葉廖緬科生於馬爾科夫卡（今盧甘斯克州）一個烏克蘭貧農家庭。1913至1917年他在舊軍隊服役，一戰時為列兵。1918年他組織游擊隊，其後併入紅軍（立陶宛通用百科全書則記他1919年起在紅軍）；1935年自伏龍芝軍事學院畢業。1941年6月30日他接替巴甫洛夫任西方面軍司令至7月2日，7月19日至29日再任，並參與斯摩棱斯克附近的戰鬥；8月起指揮新成立的布良斯克方面軍至10月。1941年12月至1942年2月他指揮第4突擊集團軍。
body.en: Yeremenko was born in Markovka, in today’s Luhansk region, to a poor Ukrainian peasant family. He served in the old army from 1913 to 1917, fighting in the First World War as a private. In 1918 he organised a partisan detachment that later merged into the Red Army (the Lithuanian encyclopedia dates his Red Army service from 1919), and he graduated from the Frunze Military Academy in 1935. On 30 June 1941 he succeeded Pavlov as commander of the Western Front until 2 July, and again from 19 to 29 July, and he fought in the battles near Smolensk; from August to October he commanded the newly formed Bryansk Front. From December 1941 to February 1942 he commanded the 4th Shock Army.

body.en: From August 1942 Yeremenko commanded the South Eastern Front, formed on 7 August, which was renamed the Stalingrad Front (second formation) on 30 September 1942 and remained under him; he also commanded the first-formation Stalingrad Front until 30 September, and he took part in the Battle of Stalingrad. At the turn of 1942–43 (31 December 1942 / 1 January 1943) the Stalingrad Front became the Southern Front. The Lithuanian encyclopedia dates his commands as South Eastern Front August-September 1942, Stalingrad Front August-December 1942 and Southern Front January-February 1943.

Before the war he was a division chief of staff, chief of staff of the Kiev Military District and head of the Operations Directorate of the General Staff. The Belgorod State University profile says he was transferred to the General Staff in 1940.

body.zh-Hant: 《大蘇維埃百科全書》載，瓦圖京1941年7月至1942年5月任西北方面軍參謀長，1942年5至7月任副總參謀長。他1942年7至10月指揮沃羅涅日方面軍，1942年10月至1943年3月指揮西南方面軍。別爾哥羅德國立大學的簡介稱，1942年12月他的部隊進行了中頓河戰役。
body.en: The Great Soviet Encyclopedia records that Vatutin was chief of staff of the North-Western Front from July 1941 to May 1942 and deputy chief of the General Staff from May to July 1942. He commanded the Voronezh Front from July to October 1942 and the South-Western Front from October 1942 to March 1943. The Belgorod State University profile says that in December 1942 his troops carried out the Middle Don operation.

body.zh-Hant: 別爾哥羅德國立大學的簡介載，瓦圖京1943年3月再度受命指揮沃羅涅日方面軍，部隊於1943年11月參與解放基輔。《大蘇維埃百科全書》載他1943年10月至1944年3月指揮烏克蘭第1方面軍，其部隊參與了史達林格勒與庫爾斯克戰役。1944年2月29日他前往部隊，途中遭游擊隊襲擊負傷，4月15日夜間因敗血症去世。
body.en: The Belgorod State University profile says that in March 1943 Vatutin was again appointed commander of the Voronezh Front, whose troops took part in the liberation of Kiev in November 1943. The Great Soviet Encyclopedia says he commanded the 1st Ukrainian Front from October 1943 to March 1944 and that his troops took part in the Stalingrad and Kursk battles. On 29 February 1944 he left for the troops, was ambushed on the way and wounded, and died of blood poisoning on the night of 15 April 1944.
